thread:
anya: Heads-up: I built a quick staging handoff map for ACME private onramp. Main risks = KMS gating, burst prewarm, and model fallback sequencing. posting for alignment.
james: share the map plz. need to plan runtimes and canary steps.
anya: paste: 
- Product: finalize launch criteria (SLA windows, rollback triggers, cost cap)
- Runtime: 4-bit quantized build + routing fallback + KV warmup runbook
- Infra: reserve GPU pool + preemption guard + hosted fallback tag
- Security: BYOK onboarding path + HSM GA plan + audit forwarder
This needs owners + dates so we can confirm pilot timeline.
matt: customer wants end-May. is that feasible?
li: infra reality: if we sign reserve capacity today we can have pool by 2026-05-09. preemption guard is non-trivial (safety checks + testing) ~3w. hosted fallback is cheap to enable.
james: runtime: quantized build depends on tuning ops/kernel selection; estimate 2w for a working 4-bit artifact + 1w integration for routing/fallback. KV cache warmup script is small but needs canary runs.
tess: security: BYOK onboarding is fastest (1 week); HSM adds another sprint for SOC checks. BYOK still needs audit forwarding and redaction rules.
anya: decision ask: BYOK for pilot or require HSM? customer ok with BYOK for pilot. suggestion: pilot=BYOK, GA=HSM.
matt: agree. that gives schedule slack.
li: infra action list:
- reserve pool: owner=li; ETA=2026-05-09
- preemption guard: owner=li; ETA=2026-05-27
- hosted-fallback tagging: owner=infra-sre; ETA=2026-04-20 (cc deploy-bot)
james: runtime tasks:
- quantized build (4-bit): owner=james; ETA=2026-04-28
- routing + fallback wiring: owner=james; ETA=2026-05-05
- canary KV warmup script: owner=runtime-sig; ETA=2026-05-08
tess: security tasks:
- BYOK onboarding doc + checklist: owner=tess; ETA=2026-04-25
- lightweight audit forwarder: owner=tess; ETA=2026-04-30
- HSM GA plan: owner=tess; ETA=2026-06-07
anya: product tasks:
- launch criteria doc (SLA, rollback, success metrics, cost cap): owner=anya; ETA=2026-04-20
- customer acceptance checklist (includes fallback behavior & cost cap): owner=matt; ETA=2026-04-22
matt: I'll include a short section defining the cost cap for hosted fallback (pilot): $2k/week. product approved.
james: question: can we route pilot traffic that would exceed reserve pool to hosted with a strict rate limit and tagging for billing?
li: yes. infra will add a routing tag and track billing. need product signoff for exposure.
anya: signoff noted. gating rule I'm proposing for kickoff: all three must be true -> (1) reserve pool exists OR preemption guard merged, (2) BYOK onboarding doc published, (3) quantized build passes smoke tests.
james: alternate soft gate: allow hosted fallback under cost cap if reserve pool is delayed. need runbook. I'll post a short fallback runbook.
li: infra will create a preflight ticket and ping owners when it's ready. ETA for ticket creation: 2026-04-16.
tess: will run a log-scan to ensure KMS tokens are redacted before pilot traffic. ETA: 2026-04-18.
deploy-bot: deploy candidate "acme-onramp-quantized" to staging initiated by james at 2026-04-15T09:12Z :rocket:
james: staging shows KV warmup ~18s for 2k prefixes. good baseline.
matt: I'll block customer kickoff until (a) product doc published, (b) reserve pool provisioned or preempt guard merged.
anya: short recap of owners & dates:
- li: reserve pool (2026-05-09), preempt guard (2026-05-27), hosted tag (2026-04-20)
- james: quant build (2026-04-28), routing+fallback (2026-05-05), KV script (2026-05-08)
- tess: BYOK doc (2026-04-25), audit forwarder (2026-04-30), HSM plan (2026-06-07)
- anya: launch criteria doc (2026-04-20)
- matt: acceptance checklist + cost cap (2026-04-22)
Next sync: propose 2026-04-18 10:00 for 20m if preflight ticket exists, else move to 2026-04-20. :calendar:
matt: noted, I'll update the checklist and add fallback section today.
james: will post the runtime fallback runbook in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
li: creating infra preflight ticket now and tagging owners.
anya: thanks all, will start the launch criteria doc and drop the link here when ready. :thumbsup:
